text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
CORN/SOY SALE - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp on Wednesday bought a combined shipment of 18,000 tonnes U.S. corn and 12,000 U.S. soybean from Zennoh at a tender.
RICE SALE - Jordan bought on Tuesday a total of 15,000 tonnes optional origin medium grain camolino milled rice, U.S. exporters and traders said. The shipment period was slated for September.

WHEAT SALE - The CCC bought 4,100 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for donation to Bosnia. The wheat was purchased from Cargill Inc at $148.58 a tonne, FOB for delivery during the period of August 15 to September 5.
CORN/SOY TENDER - Taiwan is expected to tender for up to 108,000 tonnes corn and 54,000 tonnes soybeans this week.
WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq is in the world grain market with a tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for August or September, European grain traders said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Jordan is tendering on August 12 for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat. One shipment of 50,000 tonnes is for October delivery and the rest for November, European traders said.
- Morocco was seeking a total of 120,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat to be delivered in August and September, European traders said. Offers were due August 4.
- The CCC was seeking on July 30 up to 3,530 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Honduras. Shipment period was set Aug 15-Sept 5.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC was seeking up to 6,500 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Armenia and 6,500 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat for donation to Georgia. Shipment was slated for Aug 20-Sept 8. Offers are due August 5.

Armenia was also seeking about 1,000 to 1,500 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better HRW wheat in bulk under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said. Delivery dates were set for Aug 20-Sept 8 and offers were due Aug 5.

VEGOIL TENDERS - El Salvador has cancelled its tender for 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow (PBSY) cottonseed oil in bulk and 750 to 1,250 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said. No reason was given.

- Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking on August 19 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.

VEGOIL, RICE, FLOUR TENDERS - The CCC was seeking a total of 10,470 tonnes of rice, vegetable oil, sunflower oil and all purpose flour for donation to Kyrgyzstan, Georgia and Bosnia. Offers for all commodities were due August 6. It was tendering 1,500 tonnes rice in 50 kg bags for Kyrgyzstan, 750 tonnes vegetable oil and another 1,450 tonnes vegetable oil, packaged in plastic bottles for Kyrgyzstan. It also included 2,695 tonnes of sunflower oil for Georgia and 1,250 tonnes sunflower oil for Bosnia. It also comprised 1,075 tonnes all purpose flour for Georgia and 1,750 tonnes flour for Bosnia. Shipping period was set for Aug 21-Sept 5.

MARKET TALK - The Philippines, faced with U.S. warnings of trade sanctions for failing to meet commitments on frozen pork imports last year, plans to relax rules on local importers of agricultural products, a senior official said.

... Brazilian traders said China last week cancelled 150,000 tonnes of South American soymeal but they had not heard of any more recent cancellations. "What I have confirmed is that one client cancelled 150,000 tonnes soymeal," said a soymeal trader. "That was last week." Eighty percent of that quantity was from Argentina, he said.
